The '''Talravin casino''' was operating on [[Talravin]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. A [[Unidentified Rodian thief|Rodian thief]] once broke into its vault, but accidentially locked himself inside. He was forced to broadcast a plea for help in exchange for most of the valuables inside the vault.<ref>{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Treasure Hunting|Sealed in Stupidity}}</ref>
